mainEntity.name: Who can lodge my BAS for a fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only a registered BAS Agent (or tax agent) can charge a fee to prepare and lodge a BAS. The registration is under the Tax Agent Services Act 2009 and is verifiable on the public TPB register. All matched bookkeepers providing BAS services in our network have verified, current TPB registration.

Most businesses lodge quarterly, but some lodge monthly (large PAYG withholders) or annually (small GST turnover). Your BAS agent confirms your cycle and lodges on time. The ATO publishes due dates for each period, and a registered agent typically receives an extension to lodge.

mainEntity.name: I am several BAS periods behind — can you help?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — tell us in the questionnaire that you need catch-up work. Our network includes bookkeepers experienced in bringing overdue BAS current, reconciling old periods, and, where relevant, requesting remission of failure-to-lodge penalties. Getting current is one of the most common reasons people use our matching.

mainEntity.name: How much does BAS preparation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: BAS preparation costs vary depending on transaction volume and complexity. The matched BAS Agent gives you a clear quote after reviewing your needs — the matching is free.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched BAS bookkeeper contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched bookkeeper will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.

mainEntity.name: Can a BAS bookkeeper set up my software correctly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched bookkeeper configures your GST coding, bank feeds, payroll and STP2 reporting in Xero, QuickBooks or MYOB — so your BAS is prepared accurately from the start rather than corrected later.

mainEntity.name: Is bookkeeping and BAS matching free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matching service is free for businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm, and the matched bookkeeper gives you a clear quote before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Can a BAS bookkeeper help with GST reconciliation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched BAS Agent reconciles your GST coding across all transactions, ensures input credits are claimed correctly, and identifies any coding errors before lodgement — so your BAS is accurate and you avoid amending prior periods.

Getting the BAS right consistently is the cheapest compliance you will ever buy.Registered BAS Agent — not just a bookkeeperTo charge a fee for BAS preparation and lodgement, a person must be a registered BAS Agent under the Tax Agent Services Act. You can confirm any agent's registration on the public TPB register at tpb.gov.au.Catch-up BAS and overdue lodgementsIf you are behind on BAS — one quarter or several years — tell us in the questionnaire.
